snic_superpixels — SEGMENTATION graph op

• Data kinds: image2d → table

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.snic_superpixels(image, *, n_segments: 'int' = 100, compactness: 'float' = 0.1, connectivity: 'int' = 4) -> 'Dict[str, object]' (to call the implementation directly, import seggraph; seggraph.snic_superpixels(image, *, n_segments: 'int' = 100, compactness: 'float' = 0.1, connectivity: 'int' = 4) -> 'Dict[str, object]'; from the registry, opssegmentation.get("snic_superpixels"))

Usage

SNIC (Algorithm 1 of Achanta–Süsstrunk 2017): non-iterative superpixels grown from grid seeds with a priority queue (snic_superpixels).

Distance d² = |Δx|²/s² + |Δc|²/m² (s = √(N/K), m = compactness, c is the pixel value; the normalisation form of SLIC, the notation of eq. (1) is to be verified). Pops the smallest d from the priority queue; if unlabelled, labels it, updates the centroid (position and value) on the spot, and pushes the unlabelled neighbours with their distance to the current centroid. Ties are broken by (distance, push order) (deterministic).

Returns: labels (1..K), n_segments, all_connected (all labels are 4-connected = a flag confirming the guarantee by construction by counting), n_disconnected, sizes, seeds ([row, col] of (K, 2)), s.
